reel.caption:
Paying only the minimum due: what does a ₹50,000 card bill cost you each month?

The minimum due is usually about 5% of the bill. Pay ₹2,500 and ₹47,500 stays unpaid.
Card interest on that runs about 3.5% a month (roughly 42% a year): ≈ ₹1,663.
18% GST is added on the interest: ≈ ₹299. Total ≈ ₹1,962 for one month, before any new purchases (which lose the interest-free period too).
Illustrative; your card's rate and statement decide the real figure.
